question: What segment did the customer have at 2012/8/23 21:20:00?

details.reason: Complete results match Gold SQL; BIRD Soft F1 = 1.0
details.actual_sql:
SELECT c.segment
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.date = DATE '2012-08-23'
  AND t.time = TIME '21:20:00';
details.gold_sql: SELECT T2.segment FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T1.date = '2012-08-23' AND T1.time = '21:20:00'
